title: Your phone finds you without GPS

captions.text: Turn off *GPS,* and your phone can still !find you.!
captions.say: Turn off G P S, and your phone can still find you.
Every wifi router broadcasts a unique I D,
of where those I Ds are.

captions.text: often within *tens of metres* in a city.
*Cell towers* fill in the rest, !more roughly.!
